scope: Empirical shape consistency using archived native data, fixed baseline RV/amplitude and fixed GP hyperparameters. Changed samples and display bins are sensitivity analyses, not comparable absolute likelihoods.
limitations: White display errors are not GP-correlated significances.
The observed profile subtracts no physical template or GP, but its display weights retain baseline-conditioned fitted white scales. Common-reference subtraction can self-subtract a planet signal.
Eclipse-only reference is available on August 20 only; August 8 has no eclipse exposures.
Band averages are supported by different phases and wavelengths; apparent shape can combine phase evolution with spectral structure.
The top-1-percent pixel-RMS exclusion is exploratory and data-dependent; it is not a replacement data reduction.
